title: Deficiencies and projections
description: rb-triage-audit's output, run last over every disposition part's deficiency_notes and every digest_insufficient or needs_projection decline: every earlier pass's refusal condition resolves to 'record a deficiency instead', so the pass positioned to consolidate them is the one that runs after all of them. Both arrays are required and may be empty, matching triage-0.1.json's own rule that an empty block is still written, and is itself a claim -- a run with no deficiencies has swept every slice and found nothing worth projecting, not skipped the check.
